description: PID temperature controllers: present value, setpoints, heating and cooling MV, indicators, heater current, PID, input, output, alarm and communication parameters
source: Autonics, TK Series User Manual for Communication, chapter 2 (Modbus Mapping Table)

sources.title: TK Series User Manual for Communication
sources.note: chapter 2, Modbus Mapping Table (copy hosted by a distributor, Instrumart)

notes: Modbus RTU on RS485 (TK models with the communication option). Address, speed, parity and stop bits are parameters 218-221; the device answers after the response waiting time (222).
Addresses are protocol addresses, from 0; the manual writes them as 000001, 100001, 300001 and 400001 references with the hexadecimal protocol address in brackets.

Values are 16-bit integers shown with the decimal point of the display: temperatures and set values follow the input's decimal point (input register 1001); MV, manual reset, filter and control times are in tenths.
Coils, discrete inputs and the indicator status word (input register 1006) give the same front-panel indicators.
Display mnemonics are given with digits for the TK display's special characters (AL!L is AL1L, O@MA is O2MA).
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Model name
registers.description: 10 registers, e.g. "TK4" followed by option, power and output codes.

registers.name: Present value (PV)
registers.description: Display: PV. -1999 to 9999; decimal point per register 1001.

registers.name: Indicator status
registers.description: Bits as below; same as the discrete inputs.

registers.name: Input type
registers.description: Display: IN-T. Code from the input type table of the product manual.

registers.name: Control type
registers.description: Display: C-MD. Heating & cooling type adds 2: PID/ON-OFF and 3: ON-OFF/PID combinations (see the product manual).

registers.name: Password setting
registers.description: Display: PWD. 0 = off, 2 to 9999 = password, 1 = read-only password
